Filed `docs/ref/VAST_DEEP_GROK_THROUGHPUT.md`. Not a live probe on a Vast box — cited public benches.

**For 100 queens on one 24GB card, the limiter is KV cache, not HTTP clients.** 100 connections queue; the GPU only holds ~16–64 in-flight sequences. Cap the orchestrator at `max-num-seqs`.

**Engine:** SGLang if Mag pack/tools are a byte-stable prefix; vLLM if prompts are unique. Ollama is the wrong server (vLLM ~15–20× at c=100). TabbyAPI wins single-user INT4, loses at batch≥8.

**Numbers (24GB-class):** L4 Qwen2.5-7B c=64 — vLLM AWQ 976 tok/s, SGLang FP16 914, llama.cpp 189. 4090 8B — vLLM ~920 tok/s at 50 concurrent vs Ollama ~155. Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4 on 4090 ~196 tok/s single-stream; AWQ on A100 hits 1,476 tok/s at c=16.

**Prefix cache still matters on self-host — as throughput, not money.** Shared pack is 2–10× less prefill, ~20–60% more aggregate tok/s. Unique prompts: vLLM ≈ SGLang.

**EAGLE3 on MoE still helps at high concurrency** (+10–27% through c=200 on gpt-oss-120B). Dense 7B at c=64: measure; often a wash.

**100B+ on 24GB+128GB:** llama.cpp `--n-cpu-moe` / ktransformers, ~1–14 tok/s. Overflow lane, not the swarm. DeepSeek-V3 needs ~380GB RAM.

**$:** $0.10/hr 3090 at ~650 tok/s ≈ **$0.04/M**. Same box at 10% util ≈ $0.43/M. Hosted 8B is $0.02–0.05/M; DeepSeek Flash output is $0.66/M. Self-host wins 7B–30B-A3B near saturation; loses on 671B-class and on idle.

Copy-paste SGLang/vLLM/`--n-cpu-moe` recipes are in §7. Bench the actual instance with `sglang.bench_serving` before treating any tok/s as yours.
